caption: “Rose Coghlan as "The Watermelon," from the series Fancy Dress Ball Costumes (N73) for Duke brand cigarettes” (1889). The Metropolitan Museum of Art.
alt: A cigarette card portrait of the actress Rose Coghlan in costume as “The Watermelon,” wearing a slice of watermelon as a hat and a red collar trimmed with fruit.
bibliography: "Rose Coghlan as ‘The Watermelon,’ from the Series Fancy Dress Ball Costumes (N73) for Duke Brand Cigarettes." 1889, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York.
title: Rose Coghlan as “The Watermelon,” from the Series Fancy Dress Ball Costumes (N73) for Duke Brand Cigarettes
